text:
maria (marketing): Quick coordination thread — release is set for Fri 09:00 PT. Need final changelog PR, docs links, benchmark narrative, webinar slot, and inbound lead routing. Who can confirm timings and deliverables?
priya (eng): On changelog PR now (working title: PR #452). ETA end of day Thu. Will include engineering notes and migration steps for the legacy API keys change.
alex (product): Docs staging will be built after the merge today. I can push the staging URL and then prod link once deploy lands.
zoe (devex): For the webinar CTA, can marketing share the canonical embed snippet? I need it for the docs example and the quickstart page.
maria (marketing): Planning a 30-min webinar the Tue after launch — audience: product + devs + early customers. Bench narrative: we want 3 bullets/slides showing latency (95p), cost per 1k tokens, and throughput. Can eng provide exportable numbers and a png or svg for each?
priya (eng): Yes — I can pull 95p & p50 latency and cost normalized to tokens from the perf dashboard. Which model variants should we include?
jamie (eng): Recommend: prod (optimized), cost-tier (quantized), and small (low-latency) variants. We'll include 95p latency, tokens/sec, and an SLO line. I'll export CSV and a couple of plot PNGs and drop links here by EOD.
maria (marketing): Awesome. Also: sales needs first-48h leads flagged as high-priority. @dana (sales ops) can you create a lead tag and route to inbound-sdr queue? We also need UTM query params for tracking.
dana (sales ops): :thumbsup: I can create a "launch_high" tag and route to inbound-sdr. I need the landing URL + final UTM values from marketing (campaign, source, medium).
alex (product): Landing URL will be /launch/compare-performance once docs are live. Use utm_campaign=redwood_launch_1969 and utm_medium=email. I'll confirm final path when staging is up.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: docs/staging -> prod (estimated start +3h). CI checks passed.
priya (eng): Note in changelog: there is a breaking note for legacy API keys. We should include a migration snippet in the announcement so customers know how to rotate keys before deprecation. Marketing, want a softened wording.
maria (marketing): Draft wording for announcement: "If you're using legacy API keys, rotate to the new scoped keys before May 1 to avoid service interruption. See migration steps below." Also will include a small code block for key rotation.
priya (eng): Suggest including this snippet: ```bash
# rotate key
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/rotate -H 'Authorization: Bearer OLD_KEY'
```
zoe (devex): I'll add that snippet into the quickstart and the migration guide template. Keep it short.
jamie (eng): Canary rollout plan: 10% traffic first hour, 50% next 4 hours, then 100% over 24 hours. If we hit error rate >1% revert to previous variant automatically. Marketing — mention staged rollout in the FAQ.
maria (marketing): Good call. For the announcement timing: plan to post in #marketing and send email at 09:00 PT Fri. We want to ping sales and support 30 minutes before. Can we get a short pre-send ping from eng 30m prior to go-live to confirm no last-minute perf regressions?
priya (eng): Yep — we'll run the quick perf smoke and post results in this thread 30m before.
dana (sales ops): I'll create the lead tag now and wire up the automation to tag inbound leads for 48h after launch. Send me final landing URL and UTMs when ready.
maria (marketing): I'll assemble the final announcement doc (changelog summary, docs links, bench slides, webinar CTA, migration snippet, and FAQ including rollout) and post here 1 hour before. Will also add the email draft and subject line for approvals.
alex (product): I'll confirm the staging link once deploy completes and drop the prod URL here.
priya (eng): CSV + PNGs uploaded: https://internal.redwood/files/perf-1969.zip (will add public-safe copies to the marketing folder).
maria (marketing): Thanks all — this is exactly what we needed. I'll schedule the webinar invite after we lock the final slides. Ping me if anything slips. :rocket:
